topic: How overdraft fees compound and their recent multi-billion dollar scale

sources.claim: Overdraft/NSF fees historically generated billions annually and could stack from a single low balance via transaction ordering
sources.source: CFPB research on overdraft/NSF fee revenue and bank practices

sources.claim: Overdraft/NSF revenue is down more than 50% versus pre-pandemic levels
sources.source: CFPB Data Spotlight, 2023 overdraft/NSF revenue report
